## Objective
Make the game playable in a browser. After this task, `npm start` serves the repository over HTTP and opening `http://127.0.0.1:8000/` shows a canvas Snake game that is driven by `createApp` from `src/app.js` (another task is implementing that module in parallel; you only code against its stub signature). A dev server is needed because browsers refuse to load ES modules from `file://` URLs.

## Interface
Uses `createApp(options)` from `src/app.js` exactly as declared in the stub there: options `{ ctx, cellSize, gridWidth, gridHeight, storage, onChange }`, returned object with `handleKey(key): boolean`, `tick()`, `nextDelay(): number`, and `onChange` receiving `{ score, best, status }` where status is `'running' | 'paused' | 'over' | 'won'`.

Files to create:
- `index.html`
- `style.css`
- `src/main.js` (browser entry, not unit-testable)
- `scripts/serve.js` (Node static server)
- `package.json`
- `README.md`

DOM ids that `index.html` must define and `src/main.js` must look up: `board` (the canvas), `score`, `best`, `status`.

## Behavior
`index.html`:
1. Standard HTML5 document, `lang="en"`, `<meta charset="utf-8">`, a viewport meta tag, title `Snake`, `<link rel="stylesheet" href="style.css">` in the head.
2. Body contains a heading `Snake`, a HUD line with `Score: <span id="score">0</span>` and `Best: <span id="best">0</span>`, a `<p id="status" aria-live="polite"></p>`, `<canvas id="board" width="400" height="400"></canvas>`, and a help line listing the controls: arrow keys or WASD to move, Space or P to pause, Enter or R to restart.
3. The last element of the body is `<script type="module" src="src/main.js"></script>`.

`style.css`:
4. Dark page (body background `#020617`, light text `#e2e8f0`, system sans-serif font), content centred horizontally in a column with a max width fitting the 400px board, canvas with a 2px solid `#334155` border and `max-width: 100%`, HUD items spaced in one row, the status line with a fixed minimum height so the layout does not jump when text appears.

`src/main.js` (an ES module, run only in a browser):
5. `import { createApp } from './app.js';`. Constants `CELL_SIZE = 20` and `GRID_SIZE = 20`.
6. Look up elements with `document.getElementById('board')`, `document.getElementById('score')`, `document.getElementById('best')`, `document.getElementById('status')`, using string-literal ids exactly like that (a static test extracts them with a regex).
7. Set `canvas.width` and `canvas.height` to `GRID_SIZE * CELL_SIZE`, and get the `'2d'` context.
8. Obtain `window.localStorage` inside a try/catch (access can throw); use `null` as storage when it throws.
9. Create the app with `ctx`, `cellSize: CELL_SIZE`, `gridWidth: GRID_SIZE`, `gridHeight: GRID_SIZE`, `storage`, and an `onChange(view)` that writes `view.score` and `view.best` into the `score` and `best` elements' `textContent` and sets the `status` element text by status: `running` gives an empty string; `paused` gives `Paused. Press Space to resume.`; `over` gives `Game over. Press Enter to restart.`; `won` gives `You win! Press Enter to play again.`
10. Game loop: a function `loop` calls `app.tick()` and then schedules itself with `setTimeout(loop, app.nextDelay())`; start it once with `setTimeout(loop, app.nextDelay())` after the app is created. Never more than one pending timer.
11. A `keydown` listener on `document`: return immediately when `event.ctrlKey`, `event.metaKey` or `event.altKey` is set; otherwise call `app.handleKey(event.key)` and, when it returns `true`, call `event.preventDefault()` (this stops arrow keys and Space from scrolling the page).

`scripts/serve.js` (Node, ES module, only `node:` built-in imports):
12. Static file server rooted at the repository root (the parent directory of `scripts/`, resolved from `import.meta.url`). Listens on `127.0.0.1`, port taken from the first CLI argument, else the `PORT` environment variable, else 8000. On listening it prints `Snake is running at http://127.0.0.1:8000/` with the actual port substituted for 8000.
13. `GET` and `HEAD` only (other methods get 405). `/` maps to `/index.html`. The query string is ignored and the path is percent-decoded (malformed encoding gets 400).
14. Content types: `.html` `text/html; charset=utf-8`, `.js` `text/javascript; charset=utf-8`, `.css` `text/css; charset=utf-8`, `.json` `application/json; charset=utf-8`, `.svg` `image/svg+xml`, `.ico` `image/x-icon`, anything else `application/octet-stream`.
15. Safety: the resolved file path must stay inside the root (otherwise 403); any path segment starting with `.` or equal to `node_modules` gets 404; missing files and directories get 404 with a plain-text body.

`package.json`:
16. Valid JSON with `"name": "snake"`, `"version": "1.0.0"`, `"private": true`, `"type": "module"`, and `"scripts"`: `"test": "node --test test/*.test.js"` and `"start": "node scripts/serve.js"`. No dependencies.

`README.md`:
17. Short (under 30 lines): what the project is, `npm start` then open the printed URL, `npm test`, the controls, and a one-paragraph file map (`src/game.js` rules, `src/ui.js` drawing, `src/app.js` controller, `src/main.js` browser wiring).

## Invariants
- `test/static.test.js` is protected; it must pass unchanged. It checks the ids, the script and stylesheet tags, that every `getElementById` id in `src/main.js` exists in `index.html`, that `src/main.js` imports `createApp` from `./app.js`, and the `package.json` fields.
- Every relative import in `src/main.js` must point to an existing file and use the `.js` extension.
- No build step, no npm dependencies, no network access at any time.
- Match this style: 2-space indent, single quotes in JS, semicolons, double quotes in HTML attributes.

## Edge cases
- `window.localStorage` can throw `SecurityError` in privacy modes: handled by rule 8.
- `app.nextDelay()` changes as the score rises, so it is re-read on every reschedule, not cached.
- `scripts/serve.js` must not crash on a request for a path that percent-decodes to something containing `..` or a NUL byte: respond 403 or 400 instead.
- `HEAD` requests send headers and no body.

## Guardrails
- Create only the six listed files. Do not touch `src/game.js`, `src/ui.js`, `src/app.js` or any file under `test/`.
- Do not implement game logic, drawing or key mapping in `main.js`; it only wires `createApp` to the DOM, keyboard and timer.
- Do not run `npm install` and do not add a lockfile.
- `src/app.js` may still be a stub in your worktree (it throws when called); that is expected, so do not try to run `src/main.js`, only syntax-check it.

## Out of scope
Game rules, rendering, the controller, touch controls, deployment, a bundler, favicons, and any browser or end-to-end test.
